io.milvus.v2.utils

Class ClientUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.utils.ClientUtils

  • public class ClientUtils
extends Object
    Helper for building and validating the gRPC channel used by MilvusClientV2. Constructs Netty channels with TLS/SSL, proxy, keep-alive, and interceptor options from a ConnectConfig, and offers connection validation utilities.

      • validateHostname

        public void validateHostname(ConnectConfig connectConfig)
        Validates that the hostname can be resolved before attempting connection. This provides early failure with clear error messages for DNS issues.
        Parameters:
        connectConfig - Connection configuration containing the host to validate
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if hostname cannot be resolved
